LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.Label: Point charge
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.Desc: Charge in a straight line toward a hostile pawn within range. Damage is based on the lance's current durability, then the lance loses durability and the survivor is stunned.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.Label: Line charge
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.Desc: Charge in a straight line toward a selected cell or hostile pawn, striking, stunning, and knocking away each hostile pawn passed. A mounted rider also attacks those targets.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.InvalidTarget: Select a living hostile pawn within {1} cells.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.InvalidTarget: Select a ground cell or living hostile pawn between {0} and {1} cells away.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Weapon.MugirlOnly: Only a Mugirl can safely equip this weapon.
